description: This file defines data models related to the 'Copy Asset' feature in a data asset management system. It includes request and response payloads, as well as classes representing target asset details and replication results for the asset copy process.

classes.name: CopyAssetRequest
classes.description: Represents the request payload for copying an asset, including metadata such as operation ID, user, correlation ID, and target asset details.

classes.name: CopyAssetTargetAsset
classes.description: Contains the header fields required to specify the target asset to be created as a copy, such as site ID, asset group, process group, and other attributes.

classes.name: CopyAssetResponse
classes.description: Represents the response payload after a copy asset operation, including target asset details, lineage info, and replication results.

classes.name: CopyAssetModuleReplicationResult
classes.description: Contains the outcome of the replication process for each module involved, including counts of copied and skipped items, status, and details.
